stories.headline: COP31 tables a final text — and admits 1.5°C will be missed
stories.summary: A 10-page package tabled early Sunday never mentions fossil fuels, drops the $120bn adaptation target, and admits the Paris goal will be missed.

stories.headline: Iran claims strikes on US bases in Bahrain; Bahrain denies
stories.summary: The IRGC says missiles and drones hit four US bases, claiming two Patriot batteries destroyed. Bahrain says defences intercepted the attacks; a civilian facility burned, no casualties.

stories.headline: Russia fires 186 drones in one night; 161 downed, Kyiv says
stories.summary: Russia launched 186 drones overnight, 72 of them jet-powered. Ukraine says 161 were downed by 08:00; strikes hit 18 sites, and a block of flats was destroyed in Dymer.

stories.headline: Two tankers hit off Hormuz; one burns
stories.summary: Torkel burns at anchor off Khasab; Arina hit in the engine room. No casualties.

stories.headline: Tanker Sparta II still burning off Finland
stories.summary: Still burning at anchor off Loviisa; Finland blames a likely drone strike.
